title: Whiskey Sour
summary: A bright, balanced whiskey cocktail with citrus, sweetness, and a silky finish.
steps: Add bourbon, lemon juice, simple syrup, and egg white if using to a shaker.
Dry shake without ice if using egg white.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice or serve up.
Garnish with a cherry or lemon wheel.
notes: Fresh lemon juice makes a major difference. Avoid bottled sour mix.
